title: Standard Return and Refund Policy
raw_content:
# Standard Return and Refund Policy

## 1. Overview and Eligibility Window
Customers may return eligible hardware products within 30 calendar days from the date of confirmed delivery. The return window is strictly calculated from the delivery date recorded in the customer's order history to the ticket creation date.

## 2. Product Condition and Requirements
Items must be returned in their original packaging, including all accessories, cables, and manuals. Items showing signs of customer-induced physical damage, liquid exposure, or unauthorized modification are ineligible for refund.

## 3. Refund Review and Human Approval
Any refund action recommended by support automation must undergo human review by an authenticated support agent via the `start_refund_review` process. The system does not autonomously issue funds or initiate bank disbursements.

title: Hardware Limited Warranty Policy
raw_content:
# Hardware Limited Warranty Policy

## 1. Warranty Duration and Scope
All electronic hardware devices purchased through authorized channels include a 1-year (365 calendar days) limited manufacturer warranty starting from the confirmed date of delivery.

## 2. Covered Hardware Defects
This warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal consumer use. Covered defects include component failures, unprovoked power loss, display panel malfunctions (including more than 3 stuck pixels), and internal audio driver failures.

## 3. Exclusions
This warranty does not cover accidental drops, water ingress, cosmetic wear and tear, or damage caused by third-party power adapters.

title: Shipping and Delivery SLA
raw_content:
# Shipping and Delivery SLA

## 1. Fulfillment Timelines
Standard shipping orders are dispatched within 1 to 2 business days from order placement. Domestic delivery typically occurs within 3 to 5 business days after carrier acceptance.

## 2. In-Transit Delays and Lost Shipments
If an order remains in transit without tracking movement for more than 5 consecutive business days, the support team may initiate a carrier tracer inquiry.
